label: Python and data
summary: For scripts, packages and notebooks: work inside the project's environment, treat source data as read-only and keep results reproducible.

mcp.name: duckdb
mcp.label: DuckDB MCP
mcp.network: None, unless a query names a remote source such as S3.
mcp.warning: Runs SQL in an in-memory database that is not read-only: queries can read and write local files.

mcp.name: jupyter
mcp.label: Jupyter MCP
mcp.network: Your Jupyter server at 127.0.0.1:8888, with the token you provide.
mcp.warning: Runs code in your Jupyter kernel. Needs a running JupyterLab with jupyter-collaboration and jupyter-mcp-tools installed.

mcp.name: huggingface
mcp.label: Hugging Face MCP
mcp.network: huggingface.co. Without a login it reads public data only.
mcp.warning: Hosted service; your searches are sent to it.

mcp.name: context7
mcp.label: Context7
mcp.network: context7.com. Works without a key at a lower rate limit.
mcp.warning: Hosted service; your question and the library name are sent to it.
